# vastdata_tenant_metric_label_values_bulk (Data Source)

Read all tenant metric label values as a dictionary of label keys to values.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "vastdata_tenant" "example" {
  name = "default"
}

data "vastdata_tenant_metric_label_values_bulk" "example" {
  tenant_id = data.vastdata_tenant.example.id
}

# ---------------------
# Complete examples
# ---------------------

data "vastdata_tenant" "vastdb_tenant" {
  name = "default"
}

data "vastdata_tenant_metric_label_values_bulk" "vastdb_metric_label_values" {
  tenant_id = data.vastdata_tenant.vastdb_tenant.id
}

output "vastdb_metric_label_values" {
  value = data.vastdata_tenant_metric_label_values_bulk.vastdb_metric_label_values.values
}

# --------------------

resource "vastdata_tenant_metric_labels" "environment" {
  key           = "environment"
  default_value = "staging"
  description   = "Deployment environment tag for tenant metrics."
}

resource "vastdata_tenant_metric_labels" "region" {
  key           = "region"
  default_value = "unknown"
  description   = "Geographic region tag for tenant metrics."
}

resource "vastdata_tenant" "vastdb_tenant" {
  name         = "vastdb-tenant-mlvbulk-read"
  force_delete = true
}

resource "vastdata_tenant_metric_label_values_bulk" "vastdb_metric_label_values_bulk" {
  tenant_id = vastdata_tenant.vastdb_tenant.id
  values = {
    environment = "production"
    region      = "us-east-1"
  }

  depends_on = [
    vastdata_tenant_metric_labels.environment,
    vastdata_tenant_metric_labels.region,
  ]
}

data "vastdata_tenant_metric_label_values_bulk" "vastdb_metric_label_values" {
  tenant_id = vastdata_tenant.vastdb_tenant.id

  depends_on = [vastdata_tenant_metric_label_values_bulk.vastdb_metric_label_values_bulk]
}

output "vastdb_metric_label_values" {
  value = data.vastdata_tenant_metric_label_values_bulk.vastdb_metric_label_values.values
}

# --------------------
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `tenant_id` (Number) The ID of the tenant whose metric label values are read.

### Read-Only

- `values` (Map of String) Dictionary of metric label keys to values.
